description.text:
The ninth expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released on 7 December 2018, which introduced TAG TEAM cards: Pokémon-GX showing two Pokémon together. Pikachu & Zekrom-GX, whose GX attack can also hit one of the opponent's Benched Pokémon hard, leads it, with Eevee & Snorlax-GX, Celebi & Venusaur-GX, Gengar & Mimikyu-GX, Magikarp & Wailord-GX and Latias & Latios-GX; every Pokémon-GX in the set is a TAG TEAM. From this set, many Supporters showed trainers of the Kanto region, the setting of Pokémon: Let's Go, such as Erika, Brock and Sabrina. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 95, ending with four Trainer Rare cards marked TR, followed by full-art Super Rare TAG TEAMs and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare TAG TEAMs, and gold Ultra Rare Pokémon Communication, Judge Whistle and Brooklet Hill. In English many of its cards came out in Team Up in February 2019.

TAG TEAM cards are stronger than other Pokémon-GX, but knocking one out gives the opponent three Prize cards, the first cards with that rule. With this set Prism Star cards stopped appearing in expansions, and the Trainer Rare, a Trainer in a different picture, took their place. Some Super Rare TAG TEAMs also came in a second version, the special art, showing a scene from the story of how the two Pokémon teamed up.
